concept: A listener in an empty radio city answers a signal that may be its own echo.
setting: an empty radio city at dusk, with a single tower above wet streets
continuityRules: The listener remains a distant silhouette, never a close portrait.
Keep the tower's red beacon visible whenever the city is shown.
Use amber only for the reply signal.
cameraLanguage: quiet close detail of the receiver
transitions: hard cut on the reply pulse
productionConstraints: The visual direction is user-authored; the parser does not interpret lyric metaphor or emotion.
One approved still-image asset is required for the establishing shot; it is intentionally missing in this synthetic acceptance project.

requiredAssets.description: Wide establishing image of a lone signal tower above an empty rain-slick city at dusk; muted teal and cool grey, strong vertical antenna silhouette, no text or logos.

assumptions: Lyrics are an original synthetic test text, not a real song.
The missing image remains an explicit production requirement; the plan is not render-ready without an approved local file.
